loss_form: token-level importance_sampling surrogate (Tinker loss_fn='importance_sampling'); per-token advantage = group-standardized reward (r - mean)/std, GRPO-style; zero-variance groups get all-zero advantage and are dropped from the batch
ref_policy_kl_handling: none: no KL penalty and no reference-policy term in the objective; behavior logprobs come from the sampler snapshot refreshed every step
sampler_backend_precision: unknown/closed-stack (Tinker managed sampling backend; precision not exposed)
per_step_zvf_path: /home/claude/tinker-rl-lab/experiments/results/quick_20260704/qp3-gsweep.tsv (column 'zvf', one row per step per phase); per-group reward tensors in /home/claude/tinker-rl-lab/experiments/results/quick_20260704/qp3_group_tensors.jsonl
group_size_schedule: paired phases, fresh LoRA each: phase A G=4 with 16 prompts/step, phase B G=8 with 8 prompts/step, 16 steps each; completions/step matched at 64. Both draw from the SAME seed-0-shuffled 128-prompt GSM8K pool; G=4 cycles the pool twice, G=8 once, so distinct-prompt exposure differs (2x for G=4) while completion token budget is matched; prompt-encoding token overhead also differs (G=4 encodes 2x prompts/step)
heldout_split: none evaluated in-run; training prompts are the first 128 of a seed-shuffled openai/gsm8k train split; gsm8k test split untouched
decontamination_notes: no additional decontamination performed beyond using the standard openai/gsm8k train split as released; base-model pretraining contamination unknown/closed-stack
